title: Add navigation link to admin dashboard

requirements.text: Add a visible navigation link or button to access the admin dashboard at /admin/dashboard in the Navigation component (frontend/src/components/Navigation.tsx)

quotes: I am not able to see the admin panel in the website

acceptanceCriteria: A link or button labeled 'Admin' or 'Dashboard' is visible in the Navigation component
Clicking the link navigates to /admin/dashboard route
The link is accessible from all pages of the website
The link styling is consistent with other navigation items

constraints: Do not modify the existing route configuration in App.tsx - the /admin/dashboard route already exists
Do not change the AdminDashboardPage component implementation
Maintain the existing Navigation component structure and styling
nonGoals: Adding authentication or access control to the admin dashboard
Creating new admin features or functionality
Modifying the admin dashboard layout or data display
